claim: Patchline ships a citation- and adoption-tracking dashboard tying impact to the DOI-pinned artifact. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the DOI-pinned claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make citation-adoption-tracking-gate`.
